responsibility: Implements GCC’s value-profiling analysis and profile-driven GIMPLE transformations. This file defines histogram attachment and lookup for statements, discovers which expressions and calls should be instrumented for histogram collection, computes required counters for each histogram kind, and applies value-profile optimizations such as division/modulo specialization, indirect-call specialization, and string-operation tuning using attached histogram data. It is the main execution engine for statement-level value profile collection and transformation on GIMPLE.
same_name_distinction: This file is the implementation of value profiling over GIMPLE: it discovers profile-worthy statements, manages attached histograms, computes required counters, and performs the profile-driven transformations such as div/mod, indirect-call, and string-operation specialization. Unlike gcc/value-prof.h, it contains the transformation and histogram-management code rather than only the framework declarations.
